card.text: Moon that swaps orbits with its larger partner, Janus.

introduction.text: A large old crater flattens Epimetheus's south pole. Astronomers realized in 1978 that it and Janus were two separate moons.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces shading; terrain hidden in shadow is left empty.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 58.2 km sphere from the Cassini shape; small craters are not resolved.
